message: I purchased this for my work in the food industry where most of the ladies wear bandannas. It’s really not my thing and while looking for better alternatives, came across this head covering. I’m so happy I purchased it! I love the look, the fit (I ordered small), and the design. The satin lining around the rim of the hat is easy on the hair, and the breathable fabric at top will keep me cool. I’ll most likely be ordering more.
Nice quality and a great fit. Wouldn’t hesitate to  order another one.
It’s pretty cool. My husband likes it.

Love it and this cap fit on me like a glove even with my natural hair. Well made and it feel great. I may need to buy it again.
The hat I ordered was great quality and arrived super quickly!
Excellent service and product. Highly recommended.
